description.text: Electronic Science and Technology is an engineering discipline that combines fundamental research on the movement laws of electrons with practical design of electronic devices and systems. It is a core supporting subject for modern information technologies (such as chips, communication, and hardware for artificial intelligence). From the chips in smartphones to the remote sensing systems on satellites, from the sensors in medical equipment to the prototypes of quantum computers, its technological achievements permeate almost all aspects of human production and life.

duration.text: The Electronic science and technology at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
